clarifications: Tracked U is the k-dimensional empirical activity basis and is re-orthonormalized every stated 1 ms step.
Printed rotational drift is a coordinate rotation Q(t+dt)=Q(t)R with orthogonal R.
S11 freezes U 'once initialized'; accessible article text does not specify whether the frozen control is first aligned before drift.

bounded_audit.status: algebraic plus source-derived synthetic control; not S8/S11/S12 reproduction
bounded_audit.algebraic: For Q_t=Q_0 R_t, Q_t Q_t^T is invariant. A frozen U that already spans the same k-dimensional ambient subspace preserves rank, feature norm, covariance eigenvalues and NLMS denominator under basis rotation. Pure right rotation alone therefore does not create a subspace-tracking requirement.
bounded_audit.synthetic_setup: N=100,k=3,5000 steps,90-degree within-span rotation, latent covariance [2,.7,.2], activity noise sd .02, NLMS lr .05, 100 paired seeds.
bounded_audit.interpretation: If S11 freezes U before it has aligned, the control can conflate initial subspace discovery with tracking. If U is first aligned, pure printed right rotation should not require ambient-subspace tracking in the ideal full-rank constrained case. Exact code is required to determine which interpretation applies.
